observations: streamlined blue-grey back, silver flanks and pale belly with fine irregular scales
small terminal mouth and large dark eyes without barbels
single short soft dorsal, small posterior anal and deep forked caudal
pale translucent fins with subdued dark margins

identification_limits: Milkfish follows Chanos chanos in the inspected Ken Tam photograph. The eye surface is an appearance approximation of the transparent adipose cover; no physiological simulation is claimed.
